### Boundary reference projection — retain

`test-boundary-first-reference.py` and `boundary_first_reference.py`, `project-boundary-first-reference.py`, `resources/boundary-first/boundary-first-resources.yaml` have distinct protections: exact closed manifest/resource/consumer identities; unknown values before consistency; missing/duplicate fields; unsafe normalized paths; raw-byte parity/idempotency and digest serialization; absent/stale/unexpected/nested resources; source/consumer/parent symlink boundaries; late preflight failure before writes; first/middle/last failure rollback; KeyboardInterrupt restoration; input drift; parent-topology swap with continued best-effort recovery; bounded redacted CLI diagnostics; unrelated symlink nonapplicability. These execute actual projection functions and CLI, with independent literal manifest and expected tuples. Canonical portable contract and no-stage-policy phrase guards remain per the approved plan because equivalent omission protection is not established. The implementation-name absence assertion is weak but does not justify removing a separately governed architectural guard without stronger disposition.

### Feature/proof/model grammar — retain

`test-boundary-first-validation.py`, `boundary_first_validation.py`, `validate-boundary-first.py` and `model_layout.py` protect portable selected feature/proof support, not a revived test-spec lifecycle. Activation-named cases now exercise explicit document selection, containment, deletion/companion behavior and privacy. AdoptionReviewHandoffTests distinguish review-required success from approval, unknown/malformed input and mixed structural failure. ModelRecordTests cover all current owners, allowed portable flat paths, declared layout, nested/example rejection, missing/duplicate/malformed tables and local references. CurrentBoundaryCommandTests prove default model/example discovery, malformed JSON redaction, symlinks, empty population failure and standalone customer grammar.

All six durable fixtures have current uses: minimal/complete provide smallest owned boundary/direct proof; complex/complex-complete prove multiple requirements and direct interaction proof; semantic-omission proves structure cannot judge hidden semantics; gap proves absence of direct proof fails. Generated valid_feature/valid_proof strings provide mutation-local grammar controls. Similar positive minimal cases differ as durable-fixture integrity versus mutation starting point and remain useful.
